opening.argument: The speaker directs viewers toward paid packages that provide tokens, with the products page visibly listing tiers from Starter at €100 through Tycoon Trader at €5000. He explains that the tokens can be traded or mined for coins: “Now, what you do is you trade these tokens, or you'll mind them for coins okay? so you're mining these tokens for coin.” He then creates urgency by saying, “right now is the best time to get in here,” and links acquiring more coins to possible dramatic appreciation, asking whether they could reach “five bucks 20 bucks 50 bucks 100 bucks.” He also offers personal assistance to begin and acknowledges bonuses connected with showing others the opportunity.
